source_caption:
Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood follows Ashtray, a young man who returns to South Central Los Angeles to live with his father and cousin Loc Dog. While trying to navigate family, relationships, and neighborhood life, he gets caught up in a series of ridiculous situations.

In Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood, the film blends spoof comedy, satire, and exaggerated humor, parodying 1990s hood and coming-of-age movies such as Boyz n the Hood and Menace II Society. Directed by Paris Barclay, it stars Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, and Keenen Ivory Wayans.
